title: Universal Biospecimen Collection Protocol for Extra Material From Clinical Pulmonary Procedures
official: Universal Biospecimen Collection Protocol for Extra Material From Clinical Pulmonary Procedures
summary: The goal of this study is to develop a biospecimen collection protocol for unused biospecimens from pulmonary procedures in order to facilitate research across many different areas of pulmonary medicine and mitigate the pulmonary morbidity experienced by patients with cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

All patients over the age of 18, who are seen in the Cardiopulmonary Center and are undergoing pulmonary procedures

Exclusion Criteria:

Pregnant women and prisoners

sites.f: The University of Texas M. D. Anderson Cancer Center
